invariants_enforced.rule: Only detection rule versions in status == 'ACTIVE' may execute against normalized events. DRAFT, PENDING_REVIEW, APPROVED, SUPERSEDED, and DISABLED versions are blocked.
invariants_enforced.enforcement: DetectionExecutionService.resolve_active_rule_version returns HTTP 400 if no ACTIVE version exists

invariants_enforced.rule: If multiple ACTIVE versions exist for a single rule, execution is blocked as a governance invariant violation.
invariants_enforced.enforcement: DetectionExecutionService returns controlled error and aborts execution

invariants_enforced.rule: Executing detection rules must never alter raw evidence (IngestedEvent) or canonical normalized events (NormalizedEvent).
invariants_enforced.enforcement: Separate append-only detection_executions and detection_condition_results tables; raw logs and normalized events remain bit-for-bit unchanged.

invariants_enforced.rule: No arbitrary code execution, eval(), exec(), dynamic Python execution, or shell commands.
invariants_enforced.enforcement: Declarative JSON DSL interpreter supporting AND, OR, EQUALS, NOT_EQUALS, GREATER_THAN, GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL, LESS_THAN, LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL, CONTAINS, IN, EXISTS, NOT_EXISTS.

invariants_enforced.rule: Missing telemetry fields must yield PARTIAL, never false NO_MATCH.
invariants_enforced.enforcement: DetectionFieldResolver returns resolved=False for missing telemetry; condition evaluator sets condition_result='MISSING', producing overall execution_status='PARTIAL'.

invariants_enforced.rule: Duplicate executions are prevented via deterministic SHA-256 fingerprint: SHA-256(rule_version_id + ':' + normalized_event_id + ':' + execution_engine_version).
invariants_enforced.enforcement: Unique constraint on detection_executions.execution_fingerprint; existing record returned on duplicate execution.

invariants_enforced.rule: Every execution preserves full 10-stage traceable lineage from raw evidence vault to governance audit event.
